_doc: Settings index — the single source of truth for the Instances → Settings area. The landing list, the per-section pages, the search, and the page-assistant prompt mapping are ALL driven from this file. Add a section by adding an entry (and its page partial under pages/<id>.html); nothing else needs a hardcoded list.
title: Settings
